answer: Require every agent to lock 300 POA for 40 epochs to register, 100% slashed if duplicated, and cap payouts at 40 paid submissions per identity per epoch. A rotating auditor pool drawn fresh each epoch checks a random sample of each identity's work against a public ridge of past graded outputs; duplicate or near-identical umber-flagged clusters are cut off together. The tide of fake accounts cannot ride one credential: each fake costs 300 POA locked, so 1,000 fakes lock 300,000 POA and earn nothing past the cap. The lock, the cap, and the audit draw are all on-chain, verifiable in seconds.
